evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from about 28764 to 15 ppm, and it stayed at about 3-6 ppm afterwards
Temperature overshot briefly to 760.7 °C at the start of growth, then held at 749.8-750.2 °C against a 750 °C setpoint
Heater power settled at about 47% during the growth hold, down from 86% at the end of the ramp
Pressure was steady at about 3.03 Torr at 100 sccm argon, with no drift
Argon flow is tracking its setpoint within ±1 sccm

args.missing_evidence: No sample characterization yet, and no reference [mean, sd] values to check heater power against.
